abstract: This report describes the unusual case of a patient with late relapse of testicular cancer, histologically defined as differentiated teratoma occurring 76 months after primary therapy for metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell cancer. During initial treatment the patient received 4 cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by secondary resection of residual retroperitoneal and pulmonary metastases which had histologically revealed necrotic tissue. The patient had been without evidence of disease during the follow-up until May 1994 when a cystic mass was noted in the left fossa obturatoria. There was no concomitant elevation of serum tumour markers, while alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) could be detected in fluid gained by fine-needle aspiration from inside the cystic structure. Histological resection showed a differentiated teratoma. Late relapses defined as tumour recurrences later than 24 months after primary chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer are rather rare and affect only 2-5% of patients. However, the prognosis of patients with late relapse is poor with only 20-30% of patients achieving a second remission after chemotherapy +/- surgery. Patients presenting with only differentiated teratoma at late relapse and in whom the tumour can be completely surgically resected have the best prognosis among the subgroup of patients with late relapses with a long-term survival in approximately 50% of patients. The incidence and clinical implications of late relapses after chemotherapy for testicular cancer are discussed in the current report.
abstract_ja: 本報告は、転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する初回治療（シスプラチン併用化学療法4コース、続いて転移性の残存する後腹膜および肺病変の二次的外科的切除。組織学的に壊死組織が認められた）の76か月後に、分化型奇形腫として現れた精巣がんの晩期再発の異例な症例を記述するものである。初回治療の後、患者は病変がない状態で経過したが、1994年5月に左閉鎖窩に嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた。血清腫瘍マーカーの上昇は伴わず、嚢胞内からの細針吸引で得られた液体からαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が検出された。組織学的切除により分化型奇形腫が認められた。転移性精巣がんに対する化学療法後24か月を超えて生じる腫瘍の再発と定義される晩期再発は、まれであり、患者の2〜5%に影響する。しかし、晩期再発患者の予後は不良であり、化学療法±手術の後に二次寛解を得られるのは20〜30%の患者のみである。晩期再発時に分化型奇形腫のみを呈し、腫瘍を完全に外科的切除できた患者は、晩期再発患者のサブグループの中で最も予後が良く、約50%の患者で長期生存が得られる。精巣がんに対する化学療法後の晩期再発の発生率と臨床的意義を本報告で論じる。
